gilles-2014-reasons.does_not_establish: The reasons adolescents give do not show which one really limits use, or that fixing any of them would change behaviour.

bockstael-2015-looks.population: a test group of earplug wearers (details unknown)

rnid-2026-embarrassed.does_not_establish: Saying you would feel embarrassed does not show embarrassment is why people skip earplugs, or that a better-looking plug would change that.

who-2022-standard.does_not_establish: A WHO recommendation in a news release does not show that it binds anyone, that venues follow it, or that making plugs available changes wearing.

occ-review-2023-barriers.does_not_establish: Why industrial workers resist protection does not show why consumers do, so carrying heat, humidity or communication complaints over to consumers is an assumption.

couth-2022-musicians.does_not_establish: These musicians' reported use and barriers do not show the size of this group, or that they would pay for a better product.
